source.section: D-40 Lines 4-7, 15-20; booklet PDF page 19 Line 4; PDF page 20 Lines 16-17 and Calculation I/Tax Rate Schedule; Schedule S Calculation G-1 lines a-h (PDF page 51); standard deduction PDF pages 4 and 13 (record base.deductions cite); qualifying widow(er) with dependent child 30,000 (PDF pages 4 and 13)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 75,000.00 = 75,000.00. Federal taxable income = 75,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 43,500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). D-40 (qualifying widow(er)): Line 4 federal AGI 75,000.00. Line 5 franchise tax 0.00. Line 6 other additions 0.00 (no other-state municipal interest). Line 7 = 75,000.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 75,000.00. Line 10 0.00 (no Social Security or railroad retirement). Lines 8, 9, 11, 12, 13 0.00. Line 14 Schedule I Calculation B Line 16 0.00. Line 15 total subtractions = 0.00. Line 16 DC AGI = 75,000.00 - 0.00 = 75,000.00. Line 17 standard (same as federal). Line 18 from Schedule S Calculation G-1: line a basic 30,000.00; lines b and d age 65 (born before January 2, 1961): you age 58 (born 1967-06-14) does not count; line f 0; line g 1,600.00 x 0 = 0.00; line h 30,000.00 + 0.00 = 30,000.00. Line 19 DC taxable income = 75,000.00 - 30,000.00 = 45,000.00. Line 20 tax, Calculation I rate schedule as numbers: 4% x 10,000.00 = 400.00 + 6% x 30,000.00 = 1,800.00 + 6.5% x 5,000.00 = 325.00; total 2,525.00. (DC prints one schedule for every filing status.) (Taxable income is 100,000 or less, so the form reads the tax table: row 45,000-45,049, PDF page 98, gives 2,527; expected keeps the formula figure.) Lines 21-23 credits 0.00; Line 24 = 2,525.00.
accepted_approximations: Tax on taxable income of 100,000 or less comes from the tax tables (50-dollar rows); the projection uses the rate schedule.
